posts.post: most people who claim they don't care about their outfit are the ones putting the most effort into looking like they didn't try.
the most exhausting part of getting dressed is brands putting logos on clothes that don't need them.
women who can wear a matching set without looking like they are in pajamas are living a different life.
there is a certain kind of woman who always looks good and never talks about what she is wearing. you know who you are.
